title: Blue Mountain Beach 32 Beach Walk Lane
h1: Blue Mountain Beach 32 Beach Walk Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS- Gulf views- Private pool and spa *Pool heating is available October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $70 per day* The pool and spa heat together- Short walk to the beach- Private garage- Elevator- Top-of-the-line Coyote gas grill- Steps away from shopping and dining- EV Charger- ROKU TV (no cable)- 5 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: 32 Beach Walk Lane is a stunning 6-bedroom, 5-bathroom home that sleeps 12 in the Gulf-front community of Blue Mountain Beach. With more than 3,600 square feet of living space, this home offers lovely views from multiple balconies, an outdoor grilling area with a top of the line Coyote natural gas grill, and a private swimming pool with an attached sitting spa. Guests will love the quick 2-minute walk to the nearest beach at Spooky Lane Public Beach Access!Welcome to the first floor of this spacious 3-story home. With 3 comfortable bedrooms boasting 1 king bed and 2 queen beds, there’s plenty of room to unwind. Outside, guests can relax under the shade of palm trees, take a dip in the private pool, or unwind in the attached sitting spa. There’s also a covered grill area with a mini fridge. Also behind the pool gate, is the outdoor shower—perfect for washing off sandy feet before entering the house.The heart of this home is on the second floor, where an expansive great room boasting beautiful hardwood floors and stunning views greets guests. The living area is a cozy retreat with plush furnishings, including a sleeper sofa, for the whole family to gather around and watch TV. French doors lead to the second-floor balcony overlooking the pool below, complete with comfortable outdoor seating and an alfresco dining table. The kitchen is a sleek and modern space, complete with white cabinetry, Viking appliances, and a spacious island. The breakfast bar seats 6 for casual dining, while the adjacent dining area seats 8 for sit-down meals. There are 2 bedrooms on this floor—1 bunk room with a twin-over-twin bed and 1 primary bedroom with 2 private mini-balconies and a stacked washer and dryer in the closet.The third floor boasts a luxurious primary bedroom with a king bed, twin daybed, and private bathroom. Enjoy a refreshing drink from the small coffee bar with a beverage cooler and a Keurig coffee maker. Step out onto the private balcony with comfortable cushioned seats, while taking in the magnificent views.32 Beach Walk Lane offers all the conveniences of home with all the amenities of a resort. With a private garage allowing on-site parking for 4 vehicles—plus 5 complimentary adult bikes—it’s easy to explore the nearby shops and restaurants just south of Scenic 30A. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 12):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Adjoining Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Adjoining Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Bunk Room: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed with Twin Daybed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate*Fireplace is not for guest use.

Also behind the pool gate, is the outdoor shower—perfect for washing off sandy feet before entering the house. The heart of this home is on the second floor, where an expansive great room boasting beautiful hardwood floors and stunning views greets guests. The living area is a cozy retreat with plush furnishings, including a sleeper sofa, for the whole family to gather around and watch TV. French doors lead to the second-floor balcony overlooking the pool below, complete with comfortable outdoor seating and an alfresco dining table. There are 2 bedrooms on this floor—1 bunk room with a twin-over-twin bed and 1 primary bedroom with 2 private mini-balconies and a stacked washer and dryer in the closet. The third floor boasts a luxurious primary bedroom with a king bed, twin daybed, and private bathroom. Enjoy a refreshing drink from the small coffee bar with a beverage cooler and a Keurig coffee maker. Step out onto the private balcony with comfortable cushioned seats, while taking in the magnificent views. 32 Beach Walk Lane offers all the conveniences of home with all the amenities of a resort. With a private garage allowing on-site parking for 4 vehicles—plus 5 complimentary adult bikes—it’s easy to explore the nearby shops and restaurants just south of Scenic 30A. Book today!
